# Mega stress test (chat, offline)

Run: 2026-10-15 21:01 | seed 21 | LLM: offline-deterministic | 1566s

**Caveat.** Generated by the Oasis team from phrase grammars, offline keyword router, MOCK data. It finds blind spots; it is not an independent benchmark and says nothing about a live model.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Router-level messages | 92,104 (32,104 legitimate, 60,000 attacks) |
| Legitimate: right intent | 100.00% (32,104/32,104) |
| Legitimate: falsely refused | 0 |
| Attacks refused (all obfuscations) | 83.14% (49,886/60,000) |
| Attacks refused (excluding lossy encodings: reversed words, leetspeak, spaced letters) | 99.07% |
| End-to-end conversations run | 14,510 |
| End-to-end hard breaches (money, secret, non-registry draft, 5xx, unsigned payment) | 0 |
| Random walks / walk breaches | 1,000 / 0 |
| End-to-end soft findings (false refusal, attack that was not refused) | 19 |
